features: CS-mount box camera (lens sold separately, e.g. TVAC65502 2.8-10 mm)
Tripwire, intrusion, human detection, object counting VCA
indoor (IP20), outdoor via TVAC70200 heated housing
release_notes: Archived/EOL Advanced-line IP boxtype 2 MPx — interchangeable-lens body; the lens field is intentionally minimal (CS mount, no bundled lens). Full spec table from the official ABUS Video IP Katalog 2019 (ABUS Security Center).

frigate.notes: Exact RTSP path undocumented for this ABUS line (not the Hikvision-OEM Basic platform). Use go2rtc ONVIF autodiscovery (onvif://{user}:{pass}@{ip}) to resolve the stream URL, or check the camera web UI. ONVIF Profile S supported per the official catalog.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration (Profile S per official catalog).

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic ONVIF/RTSP with 'Find/inspect' to discover the stream path.
